verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions only general API integrations for connecting the mailbox to other tools. Nothing documents registrable outbound webhooks or Zapier triggers that fire when new mail arrives or a scan completes. A generic API does not show push-style event delivery, so a consumer would still need to poll.

support.subject: As a developer, I get webhooks (or at least Zapier triggers) when new mail arrives or a scan completes, so downstream automation starts without polling
